subject: or_legislature/2025R1/HB2986
title: Provides that an irrigation district that receives a request from a user for delivery of a lower rate or duty of water during an irrigation season may not deliver to the user a higher rate or duty of water during the irrigation season than was requested.
headline: HB 2986 did not pass

claims.text: HB 2986 was introduced in the House on January 13, 2025.
HB 2986 was still in a House committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
